title: UAPF BPMN Extension Attributes (xmlns:uapf)
description: Defines the UAPF extension attributes valid on BPMN elements. The namespace is https://uapf.dev/bpmn/v2.4. UAPF extends BPMN with attributes (not new elements) so existing BPMN parsers and viewers degrade gracefully.

default.description: References an Algorithm Card by id. The card MUST exist under the package's algorithms/ folder. Visual renderers SHOULD overlay the algorithm icon, the card id, and a risk-class indicator on the task. The card's io block SHOULD be synthesized as a sibling <bpmn:ioSpecification> on the same task so downstream gateways and data flow are visible (see chapter 13.9).
